climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A Central Coast AVA in Santa Barbara County with the most wineries in the county, in an east-west corridor between the Santa Ynez and San Rafael Mountains. It is very cool near the coast and warmer inland. Chardonnay is the main grape in the cooler west, and Rhône grapes do well in the east.
